question: Theravada is known as the official religion of which of the following neighbouring countries of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Theravada Buddhism** is the oldest form of Buddhism and is widely practiced in **Sri Lanka**.
 
• It is considered the **official religion of Sri Lanka**, with the majority of the population (around 70%) adhering to it.
 
• The philosophy of Theravada Buddhism is based on the teachings of **Gautama Buddha**, focusing on achieving liberation (Nirvana) through self-discipline and meditation.
 
• Sri Lanka has a rich tradition of Theravada Buddhist practices and institutions, including ancient temples like the **Temple of the Tooth Relic** in Kandy.
 
• The influence of Theravada Buddhism is evident in Sri Lankan art, architecture, and festivals, such as the **Esala Perahera**.
 
• Sri Lanka has also played a significant role in preserving and spreading Theravada Buddhist scriptures, particularly the **Pali Canon**.
 
• The religion has been a fundamental part of Sri Lanka’s identity since the arrival of Buddhism on the island in the **3rd century BCE**, during the reign of King Devanampiya Tissa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Afghanistan**__

 __
 
• Afghanistan is predominantly an **Islamic country**, with the majority of the population following Sunni Islam.
 
• Historically, Buddhism was practiced in Afghanistan, evident from sites like the **Bamiyan Buddhas**, but it largely disappeared after the Islamic conquest.
 
 
 
• **Bangladesh**__
 __
 
• Bangladesh is also a predominantly **Islamic country**, with Islam being the state religion.
 
• A small minority of the population practices Buddhism, primarily the **Theravada tradition**, but it is not the official religion of the country.
 
 
 
• **Pakistan**__
 
 
• Pakistan is an **Islamic Republic**, and Islam is its official religion.
 
• Although Buddhism once thrived in the region during the time of the **Gandhara civilization**, it is no longer widely practiced.
